description_en: Queries the information about Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances associated with website services
description_zh: 查询网站业务关联的DDoS高防实例信息
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo describe-web-instance-relations --resource-group-id default --domains www.aliyun00.com --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeWebInstanceRelations

parameters.description_en: The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.
parameters.description_zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。
parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.description_en:
The domain names of the website services.

> The domain names must have website service forwarding rules configured. You can call [DescribeDomains](~~91724~~) to query all domain names.
parameters.description_zh:
网站业务的域名列表。

> 域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用[DescribeDomains](~~91724~~)查询所有域名。
parameters.help_en:
The domain names of the website services.

parameters.help_zh:
